Regions / Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity

Coming soon

Students learn how systems and information are attacked and defended, from passwords and phishing to encryption.

Topics

  • Passwords and authentication
  • Social engineering
  • Encryption
  • Privacy
  • Networks and the internet
Find it on the map

Activity ideas

Unplugged ideas for each topic, to be written up as full activities.

  • Dice Passphrases · Passwords and authentication

    Students roll dice to pick words from a printed list, then count how many guesses an attacker would need to find each passphrase.

  • Phish or Legit? · Social engineering

    Students sort printed messages into real and fake, name the clues, and role-play a pretexting phone call.

  • Cipher Wheels · Encryption

    Students build paper cipher wheels, exchange secret messages, then try to crack each other's messages by counting letter frequencies.

  • Footprint Trail · Privacy

    From a trail of clue cards (a photo caption, a check-in, a team roster), students work out how much a stranger could learn about a fictional student.

  • Human Internet · Networks and the internet

    Students act as computers and routers, passing addressed paper packets across the room and handling lost and out-of-order packets.

Activities

Full activities for this region are being written. Each will be unplugged, with a teacher guide and print-ready handouts, and students will need no technology.
